rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for stating that something is definitely true or will definitely happen.

example.english: This bus will undoubtedly arrive on time today.
example.traditional: 呢班車今日一定會準時到。
example.jyutping: ne1 baan1 ce1 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zeon2 si4 dou3

rows.note: Use this when stressing your confidence that the statement is certainly true, especially before 係 or a verb phrase.

example.english: They are undoubtedly the top student in this exam.
example.traditional: 佢肯定係今次考試嘅第一名。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 ding6 hai6 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 dai6 jat1 ming4

rows.note: Use this colloquial form for a strong prediction or certainty, often before a verb and especially in phrases such as 實唔會.

example.english: They undoubtedly won't believe you if you put it that way.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 gong2 keoi5 sat6 m4 wui5 seon3
